However, tubular conductivity adaptation (_update_conductivities) is disabled in step() (resetting Dh=1, Dv=1 every frame to prevent dead-tube lock-in). High CPU latency overhead (~5-15 ms per solve).
modules.behavioral_effect: Standalone heading computation; unintegrated with MPPI/Active Inference trajectory candidate generation.
modules.implementation_type: Grid Poisson solver complete; true plasmodial flow adaptation disabled; deliberation coupling unbuilt
